impact_scope.description: A new experimental public normal-generation entry point accepts indexed or unindexed mesh positions, writes per-corner normals, and exposes a caller-supplied crease-angle parameter.

evidence: S0 has no matching declaration for meshopt_generateNormals in the selected production files.
Because this exact public entry point did not exist in S0, H0 had no obligation to call or supply inputs for it.
S1 declares meshopt_generateNormals in src/meshoptimizer.h and implements it in src/tangentspace.cpp.

H0 calls meshlet, codec, simplification, and related APIs, but contains no call to meshopt_generateNormals and therefore does not expose its indexed/unindexed inputs, result buffer, position stride, or crease_angle to fuzzing.

new_harness_obligation.description: H0 must add a call path for meshopt_generateNormals, constructing a sufficiently sized result buffer and valid mesh-position/index inputs while supplying the stride and crease_angle arguments; this call was unnecessary in S0 because the API was absent.
evidence: The new S1 signature requires caller-provided result storage, indices or an unindexed layout, index and vertex counts, vertex positions and stride, and crease_angle.
No existing H0 call reaches meshopt_generateNormals.

reason: The anchored semantic unit is the newly introduced public meshopt_generateNormals declaration and implementation. Its same-scope exposure gap is false in S0 because the API is absent and true in S1 because the unchanged harness does not call it. This creates a concrete new harness entry/call and input-construction obligation, so the fixed truth table yields NEW and requires maintenance.
